_comment: Hand-maintained address book for addresses NOT derived from the on-chain registries (external protocols, LPs, agents, and the AccessManager itself). Merged over the catalog-derived labels at resolve time. Keyed by chainId, then lowercased address. category: factory|multisig|external|agent|lp|protocol.

0xc678159179eea877608df50c26c048551a3b6a.note: 'Staked Royco ETH' — a staked wrapper whose asset is the roywstETH vault. AM-governed (authority = RoycoFactory) but deliberately NOT in src/registry, so MigrateVaults does not cover it. Accepted exception; see docs/roles/assignments.md §4.
